description: Designed from the goal: “I want to manage my lab equipment and know where each item is”.

properties.name: type

serialization.serializes_as: a single scalar value of the underlying storage type
serialization.note: Select is a schema/UI constraint over a scalar value. Obsidian has no native 'select' property type; the note stores a plain scalar.

properties.reason: Marks what kind of note this is, so you can filter one kind of note out of the whole vault.

properties.name: status

serialization.serializes_as: a single scalar value of the underlying storage type
serialization.note: Select is a schema/UI constraint over a scalar value. Obsidian has no native 'select' property type; the note stores a plain scalar.

properties.reason: Tracks where this item currently is, so you can see only what is active.

properties.name: serial_number

serialization.storage_types: text, list, number, checkbox, date, datetime, tags
serialization.note: No extra constraint. The control is only an input widget.

properties.reason: Identifies the exact physical unit, not just the model name.

properties.name: location

serialization.serializes_as: a single scalar value of the underlying storage type
serialization.note: Select is a schema/UI constraint over a scalar value. Obsidian has no native 'select' property type; the note stores a plain scalar.

properties.reason: Where it physically is, so you can find it. Suggested values come from the 2 notes in your vault that already use this property.

properties.name: owner

serialization.serializes_as: "[[Note Name]]" wiki-link inside a text property
serialization.note: Note-link picker is a UI convenience that writes a link-encoded text value. It is not a separate Obsidian storage type.

properties.reason: Who is responsible for it, linked to that person's note.

properties.name: purchase_date

serialization.storage_types: text, list, number, checkbox, date, datetime, tags
serialization.note: No extra constraint. The control is only an input widget.

properties.reason: Age of the asset, for warranty and replacement planning.

properties.name: last_service_date

serialization.storage_types: text, list, number, checkbox, date, datetime, tags
serialization.note: No extra constraint. The control is only an input widget.

properties.reason: Lets you find equipment overdue for maintenance.

properties.name: project

serialization.serializes_as: "[[Note Name]]" wiki-link inside a text property
serialization.note: Note-link picker is a UI convenience that writes a link-encoded text value. It is not a separate Obsidian storage type.

properties.reason: Relates this record to an existing project note.

properties.name: tags

serialization.serializes_as: a YAML list of scalars (or a tags list)
serialization.note: Multi-select is a schema/UI constraint over a list. Obsidian stores an ordinary list property.

properties.reason: Free-form labels for cross-cutting themes. Obsidian indexes tags natively for search. Suggested values come from the 2 notes in your vault that already use this property.
